instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

hint.label: Programming
hint.text: Programming means creating a set of instructions that tell a computer how to perform a task.

atoms.text: Penelope, Ariana and May are working on a project for school. They have to use a computer to programme a small game for the rest of their class to play. Penelope loves using this computer programme. She thinks it’s very easy and enjoys thinking about games. May loses focus really easily and struggles to pay attention to the game long enough to actually make it work. Ariana does not like programming. For some reason, she always feels lost and slower than the other kids she works with.

atoms.a: What are the girls programming on the computer for their task?
From whose point of view would creating another game be a positive thing?
Why do you think Penelope would be excited to make another game?
b: ++She enjoys thinking about games and finds the program easy to use.

atoms.a: Why does May struggle with programming?
b: She has a hard time understanding how it works

atoms.a: What might Ariana’s point of view about programming be?
b: She would love to work on more programming projects in the future.
++Programming is difficult, and she would rather read a book.

atoms.a: How might Ariana feel about being assigned another programming task?
